units.source_text: 古歌：“我心如深山，不闻飞鸟声。

en.t: An old poem says: My heart is like a deep mountain, where no sound of flying birds is heard.

units.source_text: 但望爱我者，能知我此心。”

en.t: I only hope that the one who loves me can understand this heart of mine.
It appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 此处只引用前两句，与后两句无关。

en.t: Here only the first two lines are quoted; they have nothing to do with the last two lines.
